4 اورس المَكَانُ The place produced the plant called وَرْس. (S.) ―
-b2- اورس الرِّمْثُ The [trees called] رمث produced وَرْس, a thing yellow like the [garments termed] مُلَآء; as also ↓ وَرَسَ : so it is asserted, on trustworthy authority: (M:) or became yellow in their leaves, (S, K,) after attaining to maturity, (S,) and had upon them what was like yellow مُلَآء; (S, K;) and in like manner one says of a place, اورس المَكَانُ: (TA:) or became yellow in its fruit: (A:) ―
-b3- اورس الشَّجَرُ The trees put forth leaves; (K;) as also ↓ وَرِسَ . (IKtt.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
